en: {fb:0380}{n}{e0:5B10}{spk:0080}{n}I am Ashe Bradarik, daughter of King Bradarik of Fangam.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5C10}{spk:0080}{n}I believe you all know that Fangam now faces grave peril at the hands of the traitor Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5D10}{spk:0080}{n}Many of our people have suffered unjust misfortune.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5E10}{spk:0080}{n}My father wished above all for the happiness of Fangam's people.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:5F10}{spk:0080}{n}It grieves me deeply to see that wish trampled.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6010}{spk:0080}{n}But here, many brave warriors have gathered to save the people from their suffering.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:7710}{spk:0080}{n}In my father's place, I thank you from the bottom of my heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6110}{spk:0080}{n}This is not a battle to avenge my father, but a battle to restore peace to our kingdom.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6210}{spk:0080}{n}I ask you all, have courage, and fight without yielding to the monsters Sterens commands.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6310}{spk:0080}{n}Whatever may happen, I will not run from this battle.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6410}{spk:0080}{n}I will carry on my father's will and fight alongside you to the very end.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6510}{spk:0080}{n}Surely God blesses what we do.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6610}{spk:0080}{n}Let us fight together, believing in victory.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6710}{spk:0080}{n}For Fangam.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Thank you, Ashe-sama.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We loved and revered our late king dearly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}We are grateful to receive such words from his daughter, Ashe-sama.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Every one of us here, for the house of Bradarik, for the peace of Fangam,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: swears to you, Princess, to fight this battle to the end.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you, everyone. Let us fight together to strike down Sterens, and for peace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}(Hm? Someone's here...?){n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Man: Forgive my sudden visit. Princess Ashe Bradarik.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}General Wolfram! You're safe!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes, I live on, though in disgrace.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Until I bury the king's murderer, the traitor Sterens, with my own hands,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: I cannot die, whatever may come.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:0380}I have a request I must make of you today, Princess Ashe, so I have intruded upon you, knowing full well how rude it is.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}What is it? This request of yours.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes. It concerns the army gathered to strike down Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Ashe-sama, we wish for you, as princess, to stand at its head and lead it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Me...? But...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Princess Ashe, I beg you, hear me out.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}Sterens's rebels plunder town after town, and their outrages are too many to count.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Many people are suffering under Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: What's more, the rebels use sinister monsters to wipe out the armies of the lords who resist them.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}In the midst of this, we royalists have at last made contact with our comrades scattered across the land.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: And we have prepared a plan to retake the capital, which fell to Sterens... but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: our forces are no more than even with the uprising army.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}Honestly, as things stand, I cannot say whether we can defeat Sterens's army, with the monsters' power behind it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: And so we humbly ask you to lend us your strength, Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}My strength?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Yes. Even now, many of Fangam's powerful lords{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: are still undecided whether to side with us or with the rebels.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}If we proclaim at home and abroad that the princess is safe, and that the royal line continues as the rightful house of Bradarik,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: we will surely win the support of the wavering lords and the neighboring nations!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We... no, Fangam! Fangam needs Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: I beg you, will you fight with us for the sake of Fangam?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Princess!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Carrying on the will of my father, the king, is my duty as princess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Especially as long as I have loyal retainers like you, still sworn to the house of Bradarik...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If someone like me will do, I will take on that responsibility.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I accept your request, General.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Thank you, Princess Ashe. Your brave words give me great heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Then I shall come for you tomorrow.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}All right...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
